name: biglaw-ui
description: BigLaw 2 UI: its screens over the REST API, or over a recorded engine (VITE_ENGINE=recorded).

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && vite build && VITE_ENGINE=recorded vite build --outDir dist-recorded
scripts.demo-bundle: VITE_ENGINE=recorded UI_BASE=/demo/biglaw/ vite build --outDir dist-recorded && node scripts/offline-check.mjs dist-recorded
